envelope.note:
reused: testkit.world, testkit.run, testkit.fakes
World owns HOME, the XDG roots and TMPDIR; plants go through plant_text/plant_bytes; every subprocess goes through run with timeout=60; worker PATH bins are world.tools.plant. The tool is World.stage with instrument.py beside it (HANDOFF-2026-09-13-wall-migration.md). Refusals keep the family's assert_refusal so the assertions stay the same; Result.refusal() was not swapped in. No regression rows were added because this was a behavior-preserving migration. Same 83 names.
kit gap: World.stage always lands under world.root/stage/, so tree-scan cases with lane_conf is None run the tree's own path so default conf lookup relative to the tool still hits ops/lane.conf. Worker override paths stay worker_conf.plant_executable (kit plant_text + make_executable) because they are absolute-path fixtures, not PATH names. An absent subject overwrites the kit's exit-0 stub with exit 99 so the exit-0 cases fail their own assertions.
